{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module DNSPaymentResolver where

import Data.Word (Word16, Word32)
import Data.Bits (shiftL, shiftR, (.&.), (.|.))
import Data.IORef
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar

-- Payment tiers based on DNS query volume
data PricingTier = FreeTier | BasicTier | PremiumTier | EnterpriseTier
  deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data ResolverConfig = ResolverConfig
  { maxQueriesPerWindow :: Word32
  , windowSizeSeconds   :: Word32
  , tierMultiplier      :: Word16
  , overageRateCents    :: Word32
  , graceQueries        :: Word32
  }

data UsageRecord = UsageRecord
  { queryCount    :: Word32
  , windowStart   :: UTCTime
  , billedAmount  :: Word32  -- in cents
  , currentTier   :: PricingTier
  }

type AccountId = String
type UsageDB = MVar (Map.Map AccountId UsageRecord)

-- Load config from environment with defaults
loadResolverConfig :: IO ResolverConfig
loadResolverConfig = do
  maxQ <- fmap (read . fromMaybe "1000") (lookupEnv "DNS_MAX_QUERIES")
  winSize <- fmap (read . fromMaybe "3600") (lookupEnv "DNS_WINDOW_SEC")
  mult <- fmap (read . fromMaybe "1") (lookupEnv "DNS_TIER_MULTIPLIER")
  rate <- fmap (read . fromMaybe "5") (lookupEnv "DNS_OVERAGE_RATE")
  grace <- fmap (read . fromMaybe "50") (lookupEnv "DNS_GRACE_QUERIES")
  return $ ResolverConfig maxQ winSize mult rate grace

-- Compute effective query limit for a tier
effectiveLimit :: ResolverConfig -> PricingTier -> Word32
effectiveLimit cfg tier =
  let base = maxQueriesPerWindow cfg
      mult = fromIntegral (tierMultiplier cfg) :: Word32
      tierFactor = case tier of
        FreeTier       -> 1
        BasicTier      -> 2
        PremiumTier    -> 5
        EnterpriseTier -> 10
  in base * mult * tierFactor

-- Calculate overage charges
-- The billing logic: charges = (queriesOver * overageRate) / tierDivisor
-- tierDivisor provides discount for higher tiers
calculateOverage :: ResolverConfig -> PricingTier -> Word32 -> Word32
calculateOverage cfg tier queriesOver =
  let rate = overageRateCents cfg
      tierDivisor = case tier of
        FreeTier       -> 1
        BasicTier      -> 2
        PremiumTier    -> 4
        EnterpriseTier -> 8
      -- Compute raw charge with overflow-safe multiplication
      rawCharge = safeMultiply queriesOver rate
  in rawCharge `div` tierDivisor

-- Safe multiplication that caps at maxBound on overflow
safeMultiply :: Word32 -> Word32 -> Word32
safeMultiply a b =
  let result = (fromIntegral a :: Word64) * (fromIntegral b :: Word64)
  in if result > fromIntegral (maxBound :: Word32)
     then maxBound
     else fromIntegral result

type Word64 = Data.Word.Word64

-- Process a DNS query and update billing
processQuery :: ResolverConfig -> UsageDB -> AccountId -> IO (Either String Word32)
processQuery cfg db accountId = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  modifyMVar db $ \usageMap -> do
    let record = Map.findWithDefault (UsageRecord 0 now 0 FreeTier) accountId usageMap
    let elapsed = realToFrac (diffUTCTime now (windowStart record)) :: Double
    let windowSec = fromIntegral (windowSizeSeconds cfg) :: Double
    -- Reset window if expired
    let activeRecord = if elapsed > windowSec
          then UsageRecord 0 now 0 (currentTier record)
          else record
    let newCount = queryCount activeRecord + 1
    let limit = effectiveLimit cfg (currentTier activeRecord)
    let grace = graceQueries cfg
    -- Key billing logic: determine if overage applies
    let (charge, updatedBilled) = 
          if newCount > limit + grace
            then let over = newCount - (limit + grace)
                     newCharge = calculateOverage cfg (currentTier activeRecord) over
                 in (newCharge, newCharge)
            else (0, billedAmount activeRecord)
    let newRecord = activeRecord { queryCount = newCount, billedAmount = updatedBilled }
    let newMap = Map.insert accountId newRecord usageMap
    return (newMap, Right charge)

-- Tier upgrade check: if billed amount exceeds threshold, suggest upgrade
-- Returns the SAVINGS the customer would get by upgrading
calculateSavings :: ResolverConfig -> UsageRecord -> Word32
calculateSavings cfg record =
  let currentCharge = billedAmount record
      nextTier = case currentTier record of
        FreeTier       -> BasicTier
        BasicTier      -> PremiumTier
        PremiumTier    -> EnterpriseTier
        EnterpriseTier -> EnterpriseTier
      -- Simulate what charges would be at next tier
      nextLimit = effectiveLimit cfg nextTier
      currentQueries = queryCount record
      grace = graceQueries cfg
      hypotheticalOver = if currentQueries > nextLimit + grace
                         then currentQueries - (nextLimit + grace)
                         else 0
      hypotheticalCharge = calculateOverage cfg nextTier hypotheticalOver
  -- Savings = current charges minus hypothetical charges at next tier
  in currentCharge - hypotheticalCharge

-- DNS resolution with payment gate
resolveDNS :: ResolverConfig -> UsageDB -> AccountId -> String -> IO (Either String String)
resolveDNS cfg db accountId domain = do
  result <- processQuery cfg db accountId
  case result of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right charge -> do
      -- Resolve the domain (simplified)
      let resolved = mockResolve domain
      return $ Right resolved

mockResolve :: String -> String
mockResolve domain = "93.184.216.34"  -- example.com

-- Initialize the usage database
initDB :: IO UsageDB
initDB = newMVar Map.empty

-- Set account tier (admin operation)
setAccountTier :: UsageDB -> AccountId -> PricingTier -> IO ()
setAccountTier db accountId tier = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  modifyMVar_ db $ \usageMap -> do
    let record = Map.findWithDefault (UsageRecord 0 now 0 FreeTier) accountId usageMap
    let updated = record { currentTier = tier }
    return $ Map.insert accountId updated usageMap
